title.narrative: ICMPD. Strengthening the evidence base for migration policies - Advancing the Central Migration Data Management Solution for Jordan II. 2022-2024.

description.narrative: The overall objective of this action is to support the Government of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan in managing safe, regular and orderly migration by strengthening interagency cooperation in migration data collection, analysis and management, and thereby developing the capacities of stakeholders on migration governance and policy development in line with global good governance standards. This second phase of the project will integrate the following entities into the data management solution: Ministry of Education (MOE), Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHE), Civil Status and Passport Department (CSPD), and Social Security Corporation (SSC).
